observations: Three photos show a used automotive alternator on a concrete floor.
No brand name, model number, or part number plate is readable in any photo.
The alternator is dusty with visible cooling slots and copper windings.
Photo 0 shows a side view with the pulley at the top; photo 2 shows a similar unit with the pulley at the bottom.
Photo 1 shows a front view with a central black pulley cover and finned housing.
Watermark 'U-ZION LINKS AUTO'S' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' appears across all photos.
No test equipment, receipts, or vehicle context is visible.

claims.evidence: No import documents, shipping labels, or origin marks visible in photos.
No bench test, multimeter reading, or installation shown.
Photos cannot capture bearing or mechanical noise.
Alternators carry no odometer; no service history shown.
No close-up of casing seals or screw heads to prove untampered condition.

risks.proof: Bench test video showing charging output voltage and current.
Video of the alternator running with audio.

risks.risk: Previously opened or refurbished despite 'never opened' claim
risks.proof: Close-up photos of casing screws and seals showing no tampering.
Clear photo of any part number or casting mark, plus buyer's car model.

proof_requests: Video of the alternator on a bench test showing charging output.
Close-up photos of any label, part number, or casting marks on the housing.
Video of the pulley spinning with audio to check for bearing noise.
Close-up of casing screws/seals to verify 'never opened'.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used car alternator from the photos; with all seller claims unproven, it can be priced at the worst case of not working.
